rv.q: It's all totally, soul-feedingly wonderful...its gentle uncynical warmth spills off the stage, extending a hug to an audience that wouldn't dream of turning it away.
The production embodies a spirit of communal endeavour that is badly needed at the moment.
My misgivings on that front haven’t entirely receded.
Hope, resilience, community, trust, generosity and love, Away is a musical theatre production for our times.

cn.t: Critics praise this imaginative, uplifting musical about Gander's 9/11 response as stirring theatre with minimal props and maximum heart. Audiences laugh, cry, and cheer at its generous embrace of humanity without feeling overly sentimental.
